rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking about something, including whether to do it.

example.english: I consider whether to go tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 nam2 gan2 ting1 jat6 heoi3 m4 heoi3

rows.note: Choose this when the thinking involves deliberate weighing of an issue or possible action.

example.english: The company will consider whether to raise salaries next year.
example.traditional: 公司會考慮下年加唔加人工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 haau2 leoi6 haa6 nin4 gaa1 m4 gaa1 jan4 gung1

rows.note: Use this construction when assigning A the quality or status of B.

example.english: I consider him one of us.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dong3 keoi5 hai6 zi6 gei2 jan4
